say:0:1422653001:0.text: The flowers and trees here... Feli would've loved them.
say:0:1422653001:0.source_cn: 这里的花草树木……斐利尔应该会很喜欢。

say:1:1422654001:1.text: The flowers Feli planted are of a different hue than the ones here, yet they feel the same.
say:1:1422654001:1.source_cn: 斐利尔种下的花，与这里的颜色虽然不同，但感觉很相似。

say:2:1422654002:1.text: Do you also like flowers, young man?

say:3:1422654003:1.text: Oh, is this your flower bed? I mean no offense. I just wanted to admire these lovely flowers up close.
say:3:1422654003:1.source_cn: 打扰了，这花圃是你的吗？我没有恶意，只是想近看下这些美...

say:4:1422654004:1.text: My friend loved tending to flowers. He even bred a new kind back in Sal'thorin.
say:4:1422654004:1.source_cn: 我有个朋友，也喜欢种花。他曾在萨洛克兰培育出一种新的花朵。

choice_prompt:5:1422654004.text: My friend loved tending to flowers. He even bred a new kind back in Sal'thorin.
choice_prompt:5:1422654004.source_cn: 我有个朋友，也喜欢种花。他曾在萨洛克兰培育出一种新的花朵。

say:6:1422654005:1.text: In a place that harsh, how can such lovely flowers bloom? Perhaps it's the heart of the one who tends them that shapes their beauty.
say:6:1422654005:1.source_cn: 在如此恶劣的环境下，却能孕育出美丽的花朵？那定是种花之...

say:7:1422654006:1.text: Yes, my friend Feli really loved flowers...
say:7:1422654006:1.source_cn: 是的，斐利尔……我是说我的朋友他，非常喜欢花朵。

say:8:1422654007:1.text: Our land isn't fit for growing much, and he didn't have the chance to find other kinds. So, he had to work with whatever grew around our home.
say:8:1422654007:1.source_cn: 我们那里不太适宜植物生长，他也没什么机会接触不同的品种...

say:9:1422654008:1.text: If you'd like, I can give you some flowers and seeds to bring to him. They're treasures I've raised with great care, and no others like 'em exist.
say:9:1422654008:1.source_cn: 那样的话，要不要从我这里取些花草回去送给他？这些都是我...

say:10:1422654009:1.text: These flowers are hardy and can grow almost anywhere. They're not just lovely to look at. They also have healing and culinary benefits.
say:10:1422654009:1.source_cn: 它们极为坚韧，无论何处都能茁壮成长。除了美丽，还有药用...

say:13:1422654012:1.text: Don't worry about it. I'd love to take some back to Sal'thorin to show the people. The only thing is I came in such a hurry that I didn't bring anything of value to offer in exchange...
say:13:1422654012:1.source_cn: 无妨。我确实想带些回去，让萨洛克兰的人们见识一番。只是...

say:14:1422654013:1.text: I don't need anything in return. I make friends through my flowers, and if the flowers I nurture can spread to new lands, that would be the greatest gift I could ask for.
say:14:1422654013:1.source_cn: 哈哈，不必如此！以花会友罢了。要是我培育的这些花能在他...

say:15:1422654014:1.text: But they've been so carefully cultivated, and it wouldn't be right to take them for free.
say:15:1422654014:1.source_cn: 可，这是你精心培育的品种，我不能——

say:16:1422654015:1.text: I'm not a merchant, only a gardener. To me, the true value has never been in money.
say:16:1422654015:1.source_cn: 我不是通商的商人，只是个花匠，对我而言，最宝贵的东西从...

say:17:1422654016:1.text: The love for flowers, the act of nurturing 'em, the happiness they bring to others...
say:17:1422654016:1.source_cn: 爱着花朵，想要培育花朵的心，他人从花朵中得到的喜悦——

say:18:1422654017:1.text: The sunshine, the moonlight, the wind, and the rain... all these simple, beautiful things are priceless treasures to me.
say:18:1422654017:1.source_cn: 阳光、月光、风雨，还有这些动物——这一切一切，才是无与...

say:19:1422654018:1.text: Under the watchful protection of the Ivory Tree, I know that I will be able to nurture many more species of flowers, each more wondrous than the last.
say:19:1422654018:1.source_cn: 何况，在皎月树的守护下，我一定能培育出更多的花种！

say:20:1422654019:1.text: Please tell me about the Ivory Tree.

say:21:1422654020:1.text: It's the great weaving tree you see before you. This guardian tree provides nourishment to the creatures around it, watching over everyone and everything with care.
say:21:1422654020:1.source_cn: 哈哈，就是你面前这颗起舞的大树。它是滋养周围生灵的守护之树。

say:22:1422654021:1.text: My garden thrives within the blessed reach of the Ivory Tree, which is why I'm able to cultivate such unique and special species of flowers.
say:22:1422654021:1.source_cn: 我的花圃就在皎月树的恩泽范围内，这也是我能培育出特别花...

say:23:1422654022:1.text: I understand. Thank you for the seeds. I'll take good care of them.
say:23:1422654022:1.source_cn: 我明白了。谢谢你的花种，我会精心照料它的。

say:24:1422654023:1.text: If Feli were still here, he would definitely feel very happy...
say:24:1422654023:1.source_cn: 如果……斐利尔还在，来到这里，他一定会非常幸福吧。

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: （跟因度厄一起描述斐利尔种下的花）
